paper_title: Thermal Fluctuations Induced Emergence of Umbilical Defects in Nematic Liquid Crystal Cells
equation: Equation (1), delta=0: dA/dt = mu*A - |A|^2*A + laplacian(A) + sqrt(T)*zeta
scope: The isotropic case used in Figure 2, with an interactive 192x192 mesh. Illustrative dynamics, not a numerical reproduction of the chapter figure statistics.

grid.boundaries: homogeneous Neumann, centered reflected ghost nodes

noise.assumption: Isotropic circular complex noise: independent equal-variance real and imaginary parts.
noise.reason: VisualPDE setSeed=true holds the random seed fixed each timestep. false generates temporal fluctuations.
noise.GPU_limit: Opt-in integer-hash approximate Gaussian variates with a symmetric open uniform map. Cross-device trajectories and exact CPU path identity are not asserted.

generator_details.scope: Opt-in for the local noise-* and gl-* research presets only; legacy RAND and default RANDN behavior unchanged.
generator_details.algorithm: Two stages of the 32-bit lowbias32 integer permutation. First mix floatBitsToUint(seed) with four distinct additive channel salts, then XOR the packed integer render-target cell coordinates and apply lowbias32 again.
generator_details.uniform_mapping: U = ((hash >> 9) + 0.5) / 8388608; a symmetric 23-bit midpoint grid strictly inside (0,1), exactly represented in float32.
generator_details.normal_mapping: sqrt(2) * erfinv(2*U-1), retaining the engine approximate odd inverse-erf; its asymmetric endpoint exception is unreachable for this generator.
generator_details.temporal_seed: Existing updateRandomSeed() sequence advances once per Euler step when setSeed=false. Cell and Gaussian channel have separate integer keys. No finite sample mean is subtracted.
generator_details.coordinate_bound: Packed x and y each use 16 bits, exceeding the 256x128 and 192x192 research grids.
generator_details.reason: The legacy float sin/fract hash produced a nonzero point mass at U=0, mapped only to a negative Gaussian tail; the resulting mean favored the negative phase.
generator_details.validation_scope: Measured in this browser and WebGL2 implementation with finite samples. Nominal IID errors are descriptive; this does not prove independence at every lag, absence of every possible bias, or identical trajectories across hardware.

GPU_validation.method: Direct WebGL2 RGBA32F noise-only shader draws in this browser, importing both current local randNShader implementations; 100 draws on a 256x128 grid for each initial seed.
GPU_validation.result: The negative mean and zero-uniform endpoint mass measured in all three legacy trials were absent at the tested statistical resolution with the opt-in integer generator. All three corrected first-channel means were within one nominal IID standard error of zero; both channels had near-unit measured variance and no nonfinite values.

display.phase: atan(v,u+1e-7), existing cyclic palette; bilinear interpolation of complex components before argument avoids the artificial phase branch seam
display.crossed_polarizers: (2*u*v)^2, qualitative nonnegative crossed-polarizer proxy; not calibrated experimental optical intensity

phase_interpolation.scope: Display-only native shader hook. Active only when complexPhase=true, exactly two species u v, and whatToPlot is atan(v,u+0.0000001).
phase_interpolation.sampler: textureSource1 is bound to current simTextures[1].texture by postprocess before each display pass.
phase_interpolation.algorithm: Four exact texel-centre samples of the real/imaginary pair, bilinear interpolation, then atan(v,u+1e-7). This is independent of hardware/manual texture interpolation settings.
phase_interpolation.saved_view_field: complexPhase is registered in the default options and getFieldsInView().
